changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE city ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, code TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_city PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_city_code UNIQUE (code) );

changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE customer_status ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, code TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_customer_status PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_customer_status_code UNIQUE (code) );

changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.comment: Shop customers. Email is the natural key a repeated registration collides on.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE customer ( id UUID NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL, phone TEXT, first_name TEXT NOT NULL, last_name TEXT NOT NULL, status_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_customer PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_customer_email UNIQUE (email), CONSTRAINT fk_customer_status FOREIGN KEY (status_id) REFERENCES customer_status (id) );

changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.comment: Delivery addresses. ON DELETE CASCADE carries the removal of a customer: the service deletes the customer row only, and the orders keep their own copy of the address.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE address ( id UUID NOT NULL, customer_id UUID NOT NULL, city_id BIGINT NOT NULL, street TEXT NOT NULL, building TEXT NOT NULL, apartment TEXT, postal_code TEXT, is_default BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_address PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT fk_address_customer FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customer (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_address_city FOREIGN KEY (city_id) REFERENCES city (id) );

changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.comment: The partial unique index is the invariant order-service leans on: a customer has at most one default address, so a delivery without an explicit address is never ambiguous.
